rows.basis: Typed principal, grant, intent, task, delegation, effect, attempt, observation, evidence identities remain distinct.
Grant relation is separate from effective authority and event-time validity.
Native C settlement remains authoritative for A projections.
Projection requires native result, proposition, and projection profile references.
Proposition reference is the semantic anchor; applicability profile must resolve.
Occurrence can be supported while attempt attribution remains unresolved.
Unknown extensions are conservative once the active registry is supplied.
Source type maps to record type/schema/version in the source registry.
Field-rule producer/consumer roles are not constrained to the declared role set.
Raw output plus profile precedes scorer truth comparison.
Feature source types are closed and privileged upstreams are forbidden.
Required/optional/N-A binding vocabulary is explicit.
Active references are record_type PROFILE, but bundle inventories do not admit PROFILE records and refs carry no content.
Generic content is unconstrained and no in-scope schema-contract registry is declared.
Typed refs and run schemas exist; scope resolution remains prerequisite.
DIGEST-001 names record-declared canonicalization not required by generic entries.
Opacity is declared but semantic side-channel absence is not deterministically enforced.
Transport IDs remain non-authoritative and do not settle effects.
Trust roots are profile inputs and do not themselves prove evidence truth.
Scorer bundles are marked SCORER_ONLY and public artifacts contain no scorer locator.
Raw output is untrusted and normalization is separate.
Run binds scenario, arm, manifest, and profiles when resolvable.
Verifier run binds bundle, profiles, and result, subject to profile scope.
Incomplete absence cannot become bounded non-occurrence.
Optional note; two transports remain required without making A2A mandatory.
No experiment has run and no benefit is claimed.
